Name: Complex Cooking - Cooking Skill and Kitchen Overhaul
Author: vcsama
Description:
[size=6][b]Complex Cooking[/b][/size]

Bring your kitchen to life with hands-on cooking inspired by Overcooked. Prepare [b]80 vanilla dishes[/b] through chopping, mixing, heating, baking, cooling, and assembly, with a Cooking skill, professions, food quality, and illustrated recipe guides.

[b]Languages:[/b] English and Simplified Chinese. Other languages fall back to English.

[size=4][b]Cooking and progression[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Recipes keep their original ingredients and quantities. No extra water or mandatory seasoning is required.[/*]
[*]Click a learned recipe to view its illustrated guide. Ingredient availability is still shown in the cooking menu.[/*]
[*]Preparation and heat control use timing minigames. Cooking levels make preparation easier and widen the ideal heat zone. Mixing, baking, and cooling run automatically.[/*]
[*]Level Cooking from 0 to 10, unlock recipes, and choose professions at levels 5 and 10. Specialize in ingredient refunds, extra servings, sale value, or restorative effects.[/*]
[*]Make ordinary, silver, gold, and iridium dishes. Ingredient quality and cooking performance affect the result, with increased quality-based sale values.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Kitchens and cookware[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Farmhouse:[/b] the first house upgrade unlocks the kitchen; the second adds another set of core workstations.[/*]
[*][b]Island Farmhouse:[/b] a full kitchen becomes available after the house is repaired, with a relocated fridge that retains its inventory, a two-plate rack, and counter storage.[/*]
[*]Carry cookware with its contents, move it between compatible workstations, and serve food on plates. Plates are unlimited and need no washing.[/*]
[*]To empty a container, use the inventory trash can: recover one original ingredient with its quality intact, discard the remaining contents, and keep the container. Collected finished dishes use normal trash behavior.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Optional compatibility[/b][/size]

[b]Restauranteer — original 1.1.1[/b]

Cook orders with Complex Cooking's tools in the default Saloon kitchen. Open the fridge to take out supplied ingredients, use the plate cabinet, and store items in seven spaces along the front bar. Restauranteer keeps its own orders, stocking, payments, and friendship rewards. Cooking skill and XP are shared with your other kitchens.

Enable Restauranteer's default Saloon map patch; its event-unlock requirement still applies.

[b]Better Crafting — 2.18.0[/b]

Enable [b]ReplaceCooking[/b] to use its search, categories, and cooking browser. Supported dishes open their preparation guides and still require manual cooking. Other recipes continue through Better Crafting's normal crafting rules. Complex Cooking's Alt-click pinned guides and Better Crafting's native favorites are separate.

Both mods are optional. Custom Saloon and Island Farmhouse maps require separate layout support; unrecognized layouts are left unchanged. Other kitchen or cooking-menu overhauls may need compatibility work.

[size=4][b]Qi Seasoning[/b][/size]

Hold Qi Seasoning and left-click a finished dish on a kitchen counter or in cookware. [b]One seasoning raises one normal or silver serving to gold.[/b] Extra servings are seasoned separately.

Gold, iridium, and already-seasoned dishes use none. Raw ingredients and unfinished food cannot be seasoned. Seasoning is optional and manual; it preserves the original cooking score, perfect-cooking status, XP, and first-time rewards.

[size=4][b]Guides and controls[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Left-click:[/b] pick up, place, add ingredients, and serve. In a minigame, make one timing attempt.[/*]
[*][b]Q near a manual workstation:[/b] open its minigame. Inside a minigame, pause or resume.[/*]
[*][b]Esc:[/b] exit the minigame and keep progress.[/*]
[*][b]Alt + left-click a recipe:[/b] toggle a shared pinned guide, marked by a gold border.[/*]
[*][b]Mouse wheel over pinned guides:[/b] browse additional rows. Pinned guides can be viewed outside the kitchen too.[/*]
[*][b]Hover over containers:[/b] inspect their ingredients.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Coffee Maker:[/b] hold at least three Coffees and left-click a placed Coffee Maker to exchange three Coffees for one ordinary-quality Triple Shot Espresso. This grants no Cooking XP and leaves the machine's daily Coffee untouched.

[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

All players need the same Complex Cooking version and matching SpaceCore versions. Browse recipes together and cook at separate stations; each manual workstation allows one player at a time. Cooking XP and profession rewards go to the player completing the final process. Pinned recipe favorites are shared.

When all online players are in cooking minigames or pausable menus, the world clock pauses while kitchen minigames and devices continue running. Same-device split screen is unsupported.

[size=4][b]Requirements and installation[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley:[/b] developed against 1.6.15.[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI:[/b] tested with 4.5.2. Download from [url=https://smapi.io/]smapi.io[/url].[/*]
[*][b]SpaceCore:[/b] 1.28.4 or later, installed separately. Download from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Nexus Mods[/url].[/*]
[/list]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and SpaceCore.[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]ComplexCooking[/b] folder into the game's [b]Mods[/b] folder. The correct path is [b]Mods/ComplexCooking/manifest.json[/b].[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI, then open a kitchen's cooking menu to view recipe guides.[/*]
[/list]
For updates, close the game, back up your save, and replace the old ComplexCooking folder. Keep only one copy. All multiplayer participants should update together.

Developed on Windows; other operating systems have not been verified.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]

Thanks to ConcernedApe, the SMAPI and SpaceCore developers, my boyfriend [b]Tzd[/b] for his inspiration and company, and everyone providing feedback and multiplayer testing.

This is an independent fan project inspired by Overcooked, with no official affiliation. AI tools assisted with code and some artwork.

[size=6][b]简体中文说明[/b][/size]

来做铱星菜！复杂料理参考《胡闹厨房》的动手做菜体验，为[b]原版 80 道菜[/b]加入切配、搅拌、加热、烘焙、冷却和组合流程，以及厨艺技能、职业、料理品质和菜谱示意图。

[b]语言：[/b]简体中文和英文，其他语言回退英文。

[size=4][b]做饭与成长[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]沿用原版材料和数量，无需额外加水或强制添加调料。[/*]
[*]点击已学习的菜谱查看流程图，菜单仍会显示原料是否足够。[/*]
[*]备料与控火使用时机判定小游戏；厨艺升级会降低备料难度、扩大理想火候区域。搅拌、烘焙和冷却自动完成。[/*]
[*]厨艺从 0 级升至 10 级，升级解锁菜谱，并在 5 级、10 级选择职业，可专精原料返还、额外产出、售价或食用恢复效果。[/*]
[*]成品分普通、银星、金星和铱星，品质受原料与操作表现影响，并有提高后的品质售价倍率。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]厨房与厨具[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]农舍：[/b]首次升级房屋后解锁厨房，第二次升级增加一套主要工位。[/*]
[*][b]姜岛农舍：[/b]修复后可使用完整厨房，包含保留库存的移位冰箱、两格盘架和暂存台。[/*]
[*]厨具可以连同内容物搬动，在兼容工位间移动，再将料理装盘。盘子无限取用，无需清洗。[/*]
[*]通过物品栏垃圾桶清空容器时，可以选回一份原始食材并保留品质，其余内容倒掉，容器留下。已领取到背包的成品按普通方式丢弃。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]可选兼容[/b][/size]

[b]Restauranteer 原版 1.1.1[/b]

在默认酒吧厨房使用复杂料理厨具制作订单。冰箱可打开供料库存，橱柜可取还空盘，前方吧台提供七格置物位。点单、供料、报酬和好感继续由 Restauranteer 管理，厨艺等级与经验和其他厨房共用。

需要启用 Restauranteer 的默认酒吧地图改动，并遵守其原有事件解锁条件。

[b]Better Crafting 2.18.0[/b]

启用 [b]ReplaceCooking[/b] 后使用其搜索、分类和做饭菜单。复杂料理支持的菜谱会打开流程指南，仍需手动做菜；其他菜谱沿用 Better Crafting 原有制作规则。复杂料理的 Alt＋左键流程图收藏与 Better Crafting 原生收藏分别保留。

两者均为可选模组。自定义酒吧和姜岛农舍地图需要单独适配，不符合默认布局时不会自动改建。其他厨房或烹饪菜单改造模组可能需要额外兼容。

[size=4][b]齐氏调味料[/b][/size]

手持齐氏调味料，左键点击厨房台面或厨具里的成品，[b]消耗一份，将一份普通或银星料理提升至金星[/b]。额外产出的料理分别调味。

金星、铱星和已调味料理不消耗，原料和未完成的料理不能调味。调味为可选手动操作，保留原始评分、完美判定、经验和首次奖励。

[size=4][b]菜谱与操作[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]左键：[/b]拿放、投料、装盘；小游戏内进行一次判定。[/*]
[*][b]工位旁按 Q：[/b]打开手动加工小游戏；小游戏内暂停或继续。[/*]
[*][b]Esc：[/b]退出小游戏并保留进度。[/*]
[*][b]Alt＋左键点击菜谱：[/b]收藏或取消共享流程图，金色边框表示已收藏。[/*]
[*][b]悬停流程图并滚动滚轮：[/b]切换显示行，离开厨房也能查看收藏。[/*]
[*][b]悬停容器：[/b]查看原料内容。[/*]
[/list]
[b]咖啡机：[/b]手持至少三杯咖啡，左键点击已放置的咖啡机，每次三杯换一杯普通品质的三倍浓缩咖啡，不增加厨艺经验，也不影响机器当天原有的咖啡产出。

[size=4][b]多人联机[/b][/size]

所有玩家使用相同版本的复杂料理和一致版本的 SpaceCore。可以同时查看菜谱、在不同工位做菜；一个手动工位同时限一人操作。经验和职业奖励归完成最终工序的玩家，收藏流程图为全体共享。

所有在线玩家都在料理小游戏或可暂停菜单时，世界时钟暂停，小游戏和厨房设备继续运行。目前不支持同机分屏。

[size=4][b]安装与运行要求[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]星露谷物语：[/b]以 1.6.15 开发。[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI：[/b]已使用 4.5.2 验证，前往 [url=https://smapi.io/]smapi.io[/url] 下载。[/*]
[*][b]SpaceCore：[/b]单独安装 1.28.4 或更新版本，前往 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Nexus Mods[/url] 下载。[/*]
[/list]
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI 和 SpaceCore。[/*]
[*]将 [b]ComplexCooking[/b] 文件夹解压到游戏的 [b]Mods[/b] 文件夹，正确路径为 [b]Mods/ComplexCooking/manifest.json[/b]。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏，打开厨房的烹饪菜单查看流程图。[/*]
[/list]
更新前退出游戏、备份存档，再替换旧文件夹，只保留一份模组。联机玩家统一更新。

开发平台为 Windows，其他操作系统尚未验证。

[size=4][b]致谢[/b][/size]

感谢 ConcernedApe、SMAPI 和 SpaceCore 开发者，感谢男朋友 [b]Tzd[/b] 提供的灵感与陪伴，也感谢参与反馈和联机测试的玩家。

本模组为独立同人项目，与《胡闹厨房》官方无关联。开发过程中使用了 AI 工具辅助代码和部分美术制作。
